reviews.name: Sharlene Christiansen
reviews.summary: Ravisha made two transfers feel relaxed, combining careful driving with local knowledge and a welcome sense of humour.

reviews.name: Amy
reviews.summary: Amy appreciated Ravisha’s cheerful guiding, help with translation and thoughtful extra stop, and planned to book him again.

reviews.name: Deb Pegg
reviews.summary: Sachintha adapted a last-minute day trip, combining Dambulla, local businesses, a traditional lunch and an elephant safari.

reviews.name: charitha wijewardhana
reviews.summary: Charitha warmly recommends Ranweli for its service and friendly staff.

reviews.name: Stefan G.
reviews.summary: Stefan enjoyed Sachintha’s knowledgeable, good-humoured guiding through Ambuluwawa, a herbal garden, a tea factory and a Buddhist temple.

reviews.name: Michał
reviews.summary: Michał recommends Sachintha for a welcoming Dambulla-to-Kandy journey with guided visits to temples and a spice garden.

reviews.name: Kerry Thomas
reviews.summary: Kerry appreciated Sachintha’s flexible approach to a Kandy-to-Ella journey, adjusting stops around their energy and helping with photos.

reviews.name: Kanako
reviews.summary: Kanako valued Madara’s kindness, patience and thoughtful answers throughout a long drive from Sigiriya to Ella.

reviews.name: Alexandr Samoylenko
reviews.summary: Alexandr enjoyed Naveen’s attentive guiding, local stories and recommendations, and appreciated his help with bus tickets.

reviews.name: Kyleigh Hutchison
reviews.summary: Kyleigh praised Sachintha’s careful driving and interesting stops that helped her learn about Sri Lanka.
